description: MCP Server Registry for Agent Architect

gdrive.name: Google Drive MCP Server
gdrive.deprecated_reason: Replaced by local file access via Mac Google Drive sync for files in the synced tree (faster, no network). For arbitrary Drive files outside the sync, use the hosted 'claude.ai Google Drive' connector (Anthropic-owned OAuth, configured via /mcp menu, tools namespaced mcp__claude_ai_Google_Drive__*). Do NOT reinstate @isaacphi/mcp-gdrive: its bundled OAuth client is locked to the publisher's Workspace org and returns org_internal 403s for external accounts.

credentials.notes: Requires client_id, client_secret, refresh_token in JSON
Requires GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID, GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET, GOOGLE_REFRESH_TOKEN in .env file

apple-mcp.name: Apple Events MCP Server

credentials.notes: Uses macOS EventKit + Swift binaries for Reminders/Calendar. Grant permissions when prompted.

capabilities: Reminders: full CRUD with priorities, alarms, recurrence, location triggers, tags, subtasks
Calendar: create events, search, list (via EventKit)
notes: Actively maintained (431 commits, v1.3.0)
Swift-compiled binaries for performance-critical operations
AppleScript fallback for permissions handling
Covers Reminders + Calendar via EventKit
No Docker needed - runs via npx

apple-contacts.name: Apple Contacts MCP Server

credentials.notes: Uses Apple Contacts framework via Swift. Grant permissions when prompted.

capabilities: Contacts: list, search, get, create, update, delete
Groups: list groups, view group members
Phone lookup: reverse phone number search
notes: Lightweight Contacts-only MCP server
Built in Swift with native Contacts framework
Full CRUD plus group management
No Docker needed - local binary

openai-image.name: OpenAI Image Generation MCP Server (nickdnj fork w/ gpt-image-2)

credentials.notes: Uses OPENAI_API_KEY environment variable. the user's Pro plan key is already in the shell environment.

capabilities: Image generation (gpt-image-2, gpt-image-1, gpt-image-1-mini, DALL-E 3, DALL-E 2)
gpt-image-2 thinking mode (low/medium/high) for charts, diagrams, multilingual text
Transparency support (gpt-image-1 only; gpt-image-2 is opaque/auto only)
Size options (gpt-image-2 supports up to 2000px wide with new aspect ratios)
notes: Running from nickdnj fork at feat/gpt-image-2 branch until upstream PR merges
Fork adds two tools: generate_image_gpt2 (standard) and generate_image_gpt2_thinking (reasoning mode)
thinking param shape (low/medium/high) derived from launch coverage — verify against OpenAI official spec before relying heavily
Upstream PR: https://github.com/lpenguin/openai-image-mcp/pull/9 — switch back to @lpenguin/openai-image-mcp on npm once merged + published
No Docker needed - runs via npx with prepare script triggering TypeScript build
API key inherited from environment

video-editor.name: FFmpeg Video Editor MCP Server

credentials.notes: Requires FFmpeg installed in system PATH (brew install ffmpeg)

notes: PyPI 'video-editor' package is a different tool - must install from GitHub
Entry point bug: use python -c import instead of 'video-editor' CLI
Wraps FFmpeg with natural language interface
Provides execute_ffmpeg tool
No Docker needed
Fallback: run ffmpeg directly via Bash

voicemode.name: VoiceMode MCP Server
voicemode.description: Voice interaction via local speech-to-text (Whisper) and text-to-speech (Kokoro)

credentials.notes: No credentials required. Models download automatically on first use (~1.5GB for Whisper).

capabilities: Configurable voice, speed, and VAD settings
notes: Models download on first use (~1.5GB for Whisper)
Windows may need PortAudio installed
No Docker needed - runs via uvx
Supports multiple TTS voices

pdfscribe.name: PDFScribe MCP Server
pdfscribe.description: Transforms scanned PDFs into searchable Markdown with optional RAG ingestion

credentials.notes: Supports both Anthropic (Claude Sonnet 4) and OpenAI (GPT-4o) for vision. Set AI_PROVIDER=openai to switch.
